_: PixelLab design batches for the Phase 3 first-session guide sprites (courier, compass, ring, scroll, seal). Two create_1_direction_object calls (view sidescroller), 64 slots each, 10 generations each; both left in review, nothing promoted. They are the design reference only: the birds came back 18-22 px tall for a sprite that must fly inside 20 x 16 with its wings up, their wing poses don't chain into a flap cycle, and the snap muddies them, so art/guide/build.mjs hand-pixels every frame at 1x. Raw downloads: raw/<batch>/<slot>.png; review sheets: node scripts/contact.mjs art/guide/raw/<batch> --out e2e/out/guide/<batch>.png --cols 16 --scale 6.

style.b20: tiny pixel art sprite for a warm cozy steampunk farming game, Stardew Valley style, side view, crisp 1 px dark plum outline, light from the upper left, warm brass gold copper and cream colors, flat 2 to 3 shade shading, no anti-aliasing, chunky readable silhouette, centered on transparent background, no shadow
style.b24: tiny pixel art sprite for a warm cozy steampunk farming game, side view facing right, a small shiny golden brass robot bird toy automaton, polished metal body with visible round rivets, copper metal wing plates, one big round glowing orange eye, short pointed metal beak, crisp 1 px dark plum outline, light from the upper left, flat 3 shade shading, no anti-aliasing, chunky readable silhouette, centered on transparent background, no shadow

b20.result: Birds read as plain brown sparrows (no brass, no automaton): poses only. Scrolls (30-39), wax seals (40-45) and the kraft parcel (50-51) set those designs.
